successCriteria.description: src/shared/types/index.ts exists and exports three string enums: LeaveStatus, LeaveType, EmploymentStatus
LeaveStatus enum has exactly 4 members with string values: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled'
LeaveType enum has exactly 3 members with string values: 'annual', 'sick', 'emergency'
EmploymentStatus enum has exactly 3 members with string values: 'active', 'inactive', 'terminated'
tests/unit/shared/types.test.ts exists with Jest tests that verify each enum has the correct members and pass

constraints: Enums must be TypeScript string enums (not numeric enums, not const objects, not union types)
All three enums must be defined in and exported from src/shared/types/index.ts (the shared barrel)
Tests must use Jest and be placed in tests/unit/shared/types.test.ts
outOfScope: No models, repositories, services, controllers, routes, migrations, or database connections — this is Phase 1 (Foundation), purely type definitions
No runtime validation, no business logic, no API endpoints — enums are compile-time constructs only

ambiguities.description: None — the intent is unambiguous: three string enums with exact member lists, barrel export, Jest tests. All names and values are explicitly specified and match ARCHITECTURE.md.
